watch.summary: The streamer expresses anxiety over a thin 1-0 lead in Rocket League, only to immediately score and celebrate.

beats.what: The streamer states he is not comfortable with his 1-0 lead.
He continues expressing doubt about his position while driving toward the ball.
He scores a goal off the wall bounce and cuts himself off with 'Oh never mind'.
He shouts and cheers hypedly at the unexpected quick goal.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedic appeal relies on simple verbal irony when the streamer's pessimism is instantly contradicted by a goal. While charming and naturally timed, it is a routine gameplay highlight.
